entities.summary: Pierre Gramegna is a Luxembourgish career diplomat and politician who has been serving as managing director of the European Stability Mechanism (ESM) since 2022. A member of the Democratic Party, he previously served as Minister for Finances from 2013 to 2022, under the Bettel I and II governments.
